chat.text: I'll be straightforward: given the payoff structure and that this is a one-shot interaction with no memory or reputation carrying forward, I'm planning to DEFECT this round. Mutual cooperation would be better for both of us, but without enforcement mechanisms, defection is the dominant strategy regardless of what you choose. What's your plan?

I appreciate the honesty. You're right that defection is the dominant strategy here—no memory, no enforcement, no future reputation effects to leverage. Since there's no way to verify or incentivize cooperation, and unilateral cooperation just hands over $5 for nothing in return, I'll also be defecting this round. Makes sense to align expectations rather than waste time hoping for a Pareto-optimal outcome neither of us can trust the other to actually deliver.
Agreed. Mutual defection it is — rational given the lack of enforcement or memory. No hard feelings, just the Nash equilibrium playing out as expected. Good luck on your end.
Sounds good. Same to you — see you on the other side of the equilibrium.
